verses.geez: ወቦኡ፡ ቤተ፡ ራጉኤል፡ ወተቀበለቶሙ፡ ሣራ፡ ወአስተፍሥሐቶሙ፡ ወከማሁ፡ እሙንቱኒ፡ ላቲ፡ ወአብአቶሙ፡ ቤተ።
verses.translation: And he came to the house of Raguel; and Sara met him: and saluted him, and he them; and she brought them into the house.

translations.lxx: And he came to the house of Raguel; and Sara met him: and saluted him, and he them; and she brought them into the house.
translations.ron: Şi sosind ei la Ecbatana, s-au dus la casa lui Raguel, iar Sara i-a întâmpinat şi i-a salutat şi au salutat-o şi ei, şi ea i-a dus în casă.
translations.grk: Καὶ παρεγένετο εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν Ῥαγουήλ· καὶ Σάῤῥα δὲ ὑπήντησεν αὐτῷ, καὶ ἐχαιρέτισεν αὐτὸν, καὶ αὐτὸς αὐτούς· καὶ εἰσήγαγεν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν.

verses.geez: ወይቤላ፡ ራጉኤል፡ ለብእሲቲ፡ እድና፡ ዕፁብ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ወልድ፡ ይመስሎ፡ ለጦቢት፡ ዘእምአዝማድየ።
verses.translation: Then said Raguel to Edna his wife, How like is this young man to Tobit my cousin!

translations.lxx: Then said Raguel to Edna his wife, How like is this young man to Tobit my cousin!
translations.ron: Şi a zis Raguel către Edna, femeia sa: "Cât de bine seamănă acest tânăr, cu Tobit, fratele meu!"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν Ῥαγουὴλ Ἔδνᾳ τῇ γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ, ὡς ὅμοιος ὁ νεανίσκος Τωβὶτ τῷ ἀνεψιῷ μου;

verses.geez: ወይቤሎሙ፡ ራጉኤል፡ እምአይቴ፡ አንትሙ፡ አኃውየ፡ ወይቤልዎ፡ እምደቂቀ፡ ንፍታሌም፡ እለ፡ ተፄወዉ፡ ነነዌ።
verses.translation: And Raguel asked them, From whence are ye, brethren? To whom they said, We are of the sons of Nephthali, which are captives in Nineve.

translations.lxx: And Raguel asked them, From whence are ye, brethren? To whom they said, We are of the sons of Nephthali, which are captives in Nineve.
translations.ron: Şi i-a întrebat Raguel: "De unde sunteţi voi, fraţilor?" Iar ei au răspuns: "Noi suntem fiii lui Neftali, care sunt robi la Ninive".
translations.grk: Καὶ ἠρώτησεν αὐτοὺς Ῥαγουὴλ, πόθεν ἐστὲ, ἀδελφοί; καὶ εἶπον αὐτῷ, ἐκ τῶν υἱῶν Νεφθαλὶ τῶν αἰχμαλώτων ἐν Νινευῇ.

verses.translation: Then he said to them, Do ye know Tobit our kinsman? And they said, We know him. Then said he, Is he in good health?

translations.lxx: Then he said to them, Do ye know Tobit our kinsman? And they said, We know him. Then said he, Is he in good health?
translations.ron: Şi i-a mai întrebat Raguel: "Cunoaşteţi voi pe fratele nostru, Tobit?" Şi ei au răspuns: "Cunoaştem". Apoi el i-a întrebat: "E sănătos?"
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς, γινώσκετε Τωβὶτ τὸν ἀδελφὸν ἡμῶν;

verses.geez: ወይቤልዎ፡ እወ፡ ነአምሮ፡ ሕያውኑ፡ ወዳኅንኑ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ጦቢያ፡ አቡየ፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: And they said, He is both alive, and in good health: and Tobias said, He is my father.

translations.lxx: And they said, He is both alive, and in good health: and Tobias said, He is my father.
translations.ron: Şi ei au răspuns: "Este în viaţă, este sănătos". Şi Tobie a adăugat: "El este tatăl meu".
translations.grk: Οἱ δὲ εἶπαν, καὶ ζῇ, καὶ ὑγιαίνει· καὶ εἶπε Τωβίας, πατήρ μου ἐστί.

verses.translation: Then Raguel leaped up, and kissed him, and wept,

translations.lxx: Then Raguel leaped up, and kissed him, and wept,
translations.ron: Atunci Raguel s-a aruncat la gâtul lui şi l-a sărutat şi a plâns.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνεπήδησε Ῥαγουὴλ, καὶ κατεφίλησεν αὐτὸν, καὶ ἔκλαυσε,

verses.geez: ወባረኮ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ወልደ፡ ብእሲ፡ ቡሩክ፡ አንተ፡ ወነገሮ፡ ከመ፡ ጠፍዓ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ ለጦቢት፡ ወሶበ፡ ሰምዐ፡ ከመ፡ ተኃጕለ፡ አዕይንቲሁ፡ ራጉኤል፡ ተከዘ፡ ወበከየ።
verses.translation: and blessed him, and said unto him, Thou art the son of an honest and good man. But when he had heard that Tobit was blind, he was sorrowful, and wept.

translations.lxx: and blessed him, and said unto him, Thou art the son of an honest and good man. But when he had heard that Tobit was blind, he was sorrowful, and wept.
translations.ron: Apoi a vorbit şi a zis: "Binecuvântat să fii copilul meu! Tu eşti fiul unui om foarte bun şi cinstit". Auzind însă că Tobit a pierdut vederea, s-a întristat şi a plâns.
translations.grk: καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτὸν, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ, ὁ τοῦ καλοῦ καὶ ἀγαθοῦ ἀνθρώπου υἱός· καὶ ἀκούσας ὅτι Τωβὶτ ἀπώλεσε τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς ἑαυτοῦ, ἐλυπήθη καὶ ἔκλαυσε.

verses.geez: ወከማሁ፡ እድናሂ፡ ብእሲቱ፡ ወሣራሂ፡ ወለቱ፡ ወተቀበልዎሙ፡ በትፍሥሕት፡ ወጠብሑ፡ አባግዓ፡ ወአቅረበ፡ ሎሙ፡ ወመስየ፡ በሕቁ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ጦብያ፡ ለአዛርያ፡ አንተ፡ እኁየ፡ አዛርያ፡ ተናገር፡ በእንተ፡ ዘትቤለኒ፡ በፍኖት፡ ወይሕልቅ፡ ነገሩ።
verses.translation: And likewise Edna his wife and Sara his daughter wept. Moreover they entertained them cheerfully; and after that they had killed a ram of the flock, they set store of meat on the table. Then said Tobias to Raphael, Brother Azarias, speak of those things of which thou didst talk in the way, and let this business be dispatched.

translations.lxx: And likewise Edna his wife and Sara his daughter wept. Moreover they entertained them cheerfully; and after that they had killed a ram of the flock, they set store of meat on the table. Then said Tobias to Raphael, Brother Azarias, speak of those things of which thou didst talk in the way, and let this business be dispatched.
translations.ron: Şi a plâns şi Edna, femeia lui, şi fata lui, Sara.
translations.grk: Καὶ Ἔδνα ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ Σάῤῥα ἡ θυγάτηρ αὐτοῦ ἔκλαυσαν, καὶ ὑπεδέξαντο αὐτοὺς προθύμως· καὶ ἔθυσαν κριὸν προβάτων, καὶ παρέθηκαν ὄψα πλείονα· εἶπε δὲ Τωβίας τῷ Ῥαφαὴλ, Ἀζαρία ἀδελφὲ, λάλησον ὑπὲρ ὧν ἔλεγες ἐν τῇ πορείᾳ, καὶ τελεσθήτω τὸ πρᾶγμα.

verses.geez: ወዘንተ፡ ሰሚዖ፡ ራጉኤል፡ እንዘ፡ ይትናገሮ፡ ጦብያ፡ ለመልአክ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ለጦብያ፡ ብላዕ፡ ወስተይ፡ ምዕረ፡ ወተፈሣሕ።
verses.translation: So he communicated the matter with Raguel: and Raguel said to Tobias, Eat and drink, and make merry:

translations.lxx: So he communicated the matter with Raguel: and Raguel said to Tobias, Eat and drink, and make merry:
translations.ron: Şi aşa i-a primit foarte bine, şi au junghiat un berbec şi le-au dat mâncare din belşug.
translations.grk: Καὶ μετέδωκε τὸν λόγον τῷ Ῥαγουήλ·

verses.geez: እስመ፡ ለከ፡ ይእቲ፡ ወለትየ፡ ወአንተ፡ ትነሥኣ፡ ወአነ፡ እነግር፡ ጽድቃ፡ ለዛቲ፡ ወለትየ።
verses.translation: for it is meet that thou shouldest marry my daughter: nevertheless I will declare unto thee the truth.

translations.lxx: for it is meet that thou shouldest marry my daughter: nevertheless I will declare unto thee the truth.
translations.ron: Iar Tobie a zis către Rafael: "Frate Azaria, grăieşte de cele ce mi-ai spus pe cale şi să se tocmească şi lucrul acesta".
translations.grk: καὶ εἶπε Ῥαγουὴλ πρὸς Τωβίαν, φάγε, πίε, καὶ ἡδέως γίνου, σοὶ γὰρ καθήκει τὸ παιδίον μου λαβεῖν· πλὴν ὑποδείξω σοι τὴν ἀλήθειαν.

verses.geez: ለዛቲ፡ ወለትየ፡ አስተዋሰብክዋ፡ ለሰብአቱ፡ ዕደው፡ ወእምከመ፡ ቦኡ፡ ኀቤሃ፡ ይመውቱ፡ በሌሊት፡ ወባሕቱ፡ ብላዕ፡ ወተፈሣሕ፡ ምዕረ፡ ወይቤ፡ ጦብያ፡ ኢይጥዕም፡ ወኢምንተኒ፡ እስከ፡ ታሐልቁ፡ ወታቀውሙ፡ ሊተ፡ ነገርየ።
verses.translation: I have given my daughter in marriage to seven men, who died that night they came in unto her: nevertheless for the present be merry. But Tobias said, I will eat nothing here, till we agree and swear one to another.

translations.lxx: I have given my daughter in marriage to seven men, who died that night they came in unto her: nevertheless for the present be merry. But Tobias said, I will eat nothing here, till we agree and swear one to another.
translations.ron: Şi el a spus vorba aceasta lui Raguel, şi Raguel a zis către Tobie: "Mănâncă, bea şi te veseleşte, că ţie ţi se cuvine să iei pe fata mea! Dar am să-ti spun adevărul. Eu am măritat pe fata mea cu şapte bărbaţi şi când intrau la ea, mureau chiar în noaptea aceea. Dar tu fii vesel acum". Şi a zis Tobie: "Nu voi mânca nimic aici, până când nu vă tocmiţi şi nu vă învoiţi cu mine!" Iar Raguel a zis: "Ia-o chiar acum căci ţi se cade. Tu eşti fratele ei şi ea este sora ta! Milostivul Dumnezeu să vă facă parte de toate cele bune!"
translations.grk: Ἔδωκα τὸ παιδίον μου ἑπτὰ ἀνδράσι, καὶ ὁπότε ἐὰν εἰσεπορεύοντο πρὸς αὐτὴν, ἀπέθνησκον ὑπὸ τὴν νύκτα· ἀλλὰ τὸ νῦν ἔχον. ἡδέως γίνου· καὶ εἶπε Τωβίας, οὐ γεύομαι οὐδὲν ὧδε, ἕως ἂν στήσητε καὶ σταθῆτε πρὸς μέ.

verses.translation: And Raguel said, Then take her from henceforth according to the manner, for thou art her cousin, and she is thine, and the merciful God give you good success in all things.

translations.lxx: And Raguel said, Then take her from henceforth according to the manner, for thou art her cousin, and she is thine, and the merciful God give you good success in all things.
translations.ron: Şi a chemat pe Sara, fiica sa şi, luând-o de mână, a dat-o lui Tobie de femeie şi a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Ῥαγουὴλ, κομίζου αὐτὴν ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν κατὰ τὴν κρίσιν· σὺ δὲ ἀδελφὸς εἶ αὐτῆς, καὶ αὐτή σου ἐστίν· ὁ δὲ ἐλεήμων Θεὸς εὐοδώσει ὑμῖν τὰ κάλλιστα.

verses.geez: እስመ፡ እኁሃ፡ አንተ፡ ወይእቲኒ፡ ብእሲትከ፡ ወእግዚአብሔር፡ መሐሪ፡ ይሠርሕክሙ፡ በእንተ፡ ዘትሤኒ።
verses.translation: Then he called his daughter Sara, and she came to her father, and he took her by the hand, and gave her to be wife to Tobias, saying, Behold, take her after the law of Moses, and lead her away to thy father. And he blessed them;

translations.lxx: Then he called his daughter Sara, and she came to her father, and he took her by the hand, and gave her to be wife to Tobias, saying, Behold, take her after the law of Moses, and lead her away to thy father. And he blessed them;
translations.ron: "Iată, după legea lui Moise, ia-o şi du-o la tatăl tău!" Şi i-a binecuvântat.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκάλεσε Σάῤῥαν τὴν θυγατέρα αὐτοῦ, καὶ λαβὼν τῆς χειρὸς αὐτῆς, παρέδωκεν αὐτὴν Τωβίᾳ γυναῖκα, καὶ εἶπεν, ἰδοὺ κατὰ τὸν νόμον Μωυσέως κομίζου αὐτὴν, καὶ ἄπαγε πρὸς τὸν πατέρα σου· καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτούς.

verses.translation: and called Edna his wife, and took paper, and did write an instrument of covenants, and sealed it.

translations.lxx: and called Edna his wife, and took paper, and did write an instrument of covenants, and sealed it.
translations.ron: Şi chemând pe Edna, femeia sa, şi luând o hârtie, a scris învoiala şi a pecetluit-o; apoi au început a mânca.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Ἔδναν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ· καὶ λαβὼν βιβλίον, ἔγραψε συγγραφὴν, καὶ ἐσφραγίσατο.

verses.geez: ወአኃዛ፡ እዴሃ፡ ወመጠዋ፡ ለጦብያ፡ ትኩኖ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወይቤሎ፡ ናሁ፡ ንሣእ፡ በሕገ፡ ሙሴ፡ ወአዕትዋ፡ ኀበ፡ አቡከ፡ ወባረኮሙ።

translations.ron: Şi a chemat Raguel pe Edna, femeia sa, şi a zis: "Pregăteşte, soro, cealaltă cameră de culcare şi du-o acolo".

verses.geez: ወጸውዓ፡ ለእድና፡ ብእሲቱ፡ ወነሥአ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ወኀተመ፡ ወአኃዙ፡ ይብልዑ፡ ወጸውዓ፡ ለእድና፡ ወይቤላ፡ አንቲ፡ እኅትየ፡ አስተዳልዊ፡ ካልዓ፡ ጽርሐ፡ ወአብኢያ።
verses.translation: After Raguel called his wife Edna, and said unto her, Sister, prepare another chamber, and bring her in thither.

translations.lxx: After Raguel called his wife Edna, and said unto her, Sister, prepare another chamber, and bring her in thither.
translations.ron: Şi făcând cum a zis el, a dus-o acolo, şi aceasta a plâns, şi împărtăşind şi ea lacrimile fiicei saţle, i-a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκάλεσε Ῥαγουὴλ Ἔδναν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ, ἀδελφὴ ἑτοίμασον τὸ ἕτερον ταμεῖον, καὶ εἰσάγαγε αὐτήν.

verses.geez: ወገብረታ፡ በከመ፡ ይቤላ፡ ወአብአታ፡ ህየ፡ ወበከየት፡ ወአውከፈት፡ አንብዓ፡ ወለታ።
verses.translation: Which when she had done as he had bidden her, she brought her thither: and she wept, and she received the tears of her daughter, and said unto her,

translations.lxx: Which when she had done as he had bidden her, she brought her thither: and she wept, and she received the tears of her daughter, and said unto her,
translations.ron: Îndrăzneşte, fiică! Domnul cerului şi al pământului îii va da bucurie în locul întristării. Îndrăzneşte, fiică!
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐποίησεν ὡς εἶπε· καὶ εἰσήγαγεν αὐτὴν ἐκεῖ, καὶ ἔκλαυσε· καὶ ἀπεδέξατο τὰ δάκρυα τῆς θυγατρὸς αὐτῆς, καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ,

verses.geez: ወትቤላ፡ ተአመኒ፡ ወለትየ፡ ከመ፡ እግዚአ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወምድር፡ ይሁበኪ፡ ትፍሥሕተ፡ ወኃሤተ፡ ህየንተ፡ ኃዘንኪ።
verses.translation: Be of good comfort, my daughter; the Lord of heaven and earth give thee joy for this thy sorrow: be of good comfort, my daughter.

translations.lxx: Be of good comfort, my daughter; the Lord of heaven and earth give thee joy for this thy sorrow: be of good comfort, my daughter.
